| # Frequency inputs {#frequency-inputs-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

Thanks to the characteristics of the frequency signals, many diagnostic coverage (DC) model failures (stuck-at failures, open circuit failures and short circuit failures) could be detected via direct frequency monitoring of the signal by the ASW.

Nevertheless, in order to reach a higher DC, it is highly recommended to adopt the method described in [Multi-functional inputs in general](multi-functionalinputsingeneral.html){.topiclink}.
